about: Workbook.SetPasswordEncryptionOptions on new workbooks, in memory and never saved, then the four PasswordEncryption reads, typed (Workbook) and late (Object); each answer is the call's error, then each read as TypeName:value or its error. Measured once by scripts/measure_workbook_encryption_options.py, now retired: it named cryptographic providers, and one raised smartcard prompts. Do not remeasure.
